items.d: I heard the stage setup for the masquerade has begun? I, as a fan, definitely have to help out! Don't be shy, these are old tables from Rhodes Island that were just sitting around, and I've refurbished them to suit the band's style. They'll definitely come in handy! So, please make sure to invite me to the masquerade!

These are stage decorations my bandmates and I prepared. Hope they can be of some use. As a fellow band member from Rhodes Island, if there's anything else you need help with, just ask. Even when things get tough, we play without holding back—isn't that what rock and roll is about? Let's jam sometime!

Hello, these are the lighting fixtures from your order. We've adjusted their appearance to match the requested style. After confirmation, we'll help install them on the stage. Well, I don't quite understand it, but this stage really looks so amazing and cool. If it's possible, could I bring my friends to attend too? It's sure to be a truly magnificent and unforgettable masquerade!

items.t: A Message from the Castle of Dreams
items.d:
How are the members of Ave Mujica doing? I heard that your masquerade on Rhodes Island is being diligently prepared, so please allow me to contribute as well.
These were originally furniture pieces from the Castle of Dreams, and I've sent them over to add some vibe to the masquerade. We are very much looking forward to the official start of the masquerade, and the children are also impatient. I wish you all the best.

items.t: Recording from the Castle of Dreams
items.d: Ugh... Iris asked me to apologize to you, so I just... I went too far before, and caused you unnecessary trouble. I'm truly sorry. Please take these stage backdrops Corettons and I made together... Is that enough now, Iris! Ahh, I don't care anymore, just let it be!! I really hope your masquerade is a success, otherwise Iris will surely nag me again!

note: Letters the operators sent along with their furniture gifts.
